summary: AB Private Lending Fund filed an 8-K covering Items 3.02, 7.01, and 8.01 to report an unregistered sale of 2,060 Class I shares for $50,928.80 consideration, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S; declared June 2026 distributions of $0.20/share for Class I; and disclosed NAV per Class I share of $24.72 as of May 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV of ~$163M and portfolio fair value of ~$372M. The fund is conducting a continuous public offering of up to $1.0B in shares. No special-situation event such as acquisition, restructuring, or going-private is present.
